title: branch-view
description: Today's view of a branch, from your copy: today's design with every node of the branch its node engineer signed as it is, the nodes left out and why, and every value outside the branch that moves; or why not.

shown.description: One digest of the group file and every node file the view was made from: a seal of the branch sends it, and is refused when any has changed since.

says.description: What the view is: today's design with the branch's signed nodes, not a release.

changes.description: The nodes of the branch taken in that change today's design, by id.

left_out.description: The nodes of the branch not taken, and why.

impact.description: Every value outside the branch that moves, with the nearest group it hangs under; null where it refuses or does not run.
